title: Pyspark keep ObjectId type for _id when read/write to mongodb
question:
I have a collection in mongodb with fields and _id like this:

_id: ObjectId('677d4aebcafa6974b025cbc2')

When I read it with pyspark the type of _id is string and with no changes but just write it back to the collection on append mode it create a new documents with _id: '677d4aebcafa6974b025cbc2', So just the string

I try udf with bson.ObjectId

I try struct(col(_id).alias(oid))

I change the convertJson to objectOrArrayOnly

but nothing work i'm not capable of updateing the documents by recreating ObjectId

I want to update the docs and keep in mongoDB the type ObjectId for _id
answer:
If anyone need, I succeed with the spark connector 10.4

you can use this

.withColumn("_id", concat(lit('{"$oid":"'), col("_id"), lit('"}')))

and need in the write options to add the convertJson: objectOrArrayOnly
